name: sql_query
description: Execute a T-SQL SELECT query against Azure SQL. The MCP automatically handles value matching for low-cardinality columns (status, category, etc.) so you can use lowercase/mixed case values - they will be corrected to match exact database values. Use TOP instead of LIMIT. Bracket reserved identifiers (e.g., [Case]).

query.description: T-SQL SELECT statement to execute. Use natural language values for low-cardinality columns (e.g., 'closed won', 'negotiation') - the MCP will automatically match them to exact database values.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.
